item.title: Vietnam: AI, Messaging Underpin Digital Commerce Revolution
item.description: AI, conversational commerce, and cross-border digital tools are rapidly transforming how Vietnamese businesses engage customers, drive sales and build fully integrated commerce ecosystems in 2026.

item.title: Australia: Swinburne Expands Campus-Wide Generative AI
item.description: Swinburne University has become the first globally to provide all staff and learners with campus-wide access to generative AI tools, embedding advanced creative technologies across teaching, learning and research.

item.title: The Philippines: Boosting PNP Cyber and Crime-Fighting Capabilities
item.description: A multi-billion-peso investment aims to strengthen the Philippine National Police’s crime-fighting, digital and infrastructure capabilities, including anti-cybercrime training and technology upgrades.

item.title: Singapore: Empowering the Workforce to Thrive in the AI Era
item.description: Minister Josephine Teo highlighted Singapore’s ongoing efforts to equip its workforce with AI fluency and domain expertise, actively promoting collaboration between humans and AI through the Human+ initiative.

item.title: Malaysia: Smart Incentives for Advanced Manufacturing Growth
item.description: Malaysia’s New Incentive Framework links investment incentives to technology transfer, innovation outcomes and sustainability to strengthen long term economic competitiveness.

item.title: Vietnam: Resolution No. 57 Catalyses Digital Transformation
item.description: Resolution No. 57 has significantly accelerated Vietnam’s digital transformation, boosting innovation, governance and community engagement while positioning the country as a regional leader in the digital era.

item.title: Australia: Victoria’s AI Strategy Fuels Growth and Innovation
item.description: Victoria’s AI Mission Statement outlines a comprehensive strategic framework to drive economic growth, innovation, technological advancement, ethical AI adoption, workforce development and sustainable digital infrastructure across the state.

item.title: Hong Kong: AI Drives Heightened Cybersecurity Response
item.description: HKCERT reports record 2025 cyber incidents, warning AI-driven attacks, weak governance and supply chain gaps will intensify risks in 2026.

item.title: India Gains Global Momentum with AI Impact Summit
item.description: India’s AI ecosystem is gaining strong global traction ahead of the AI Impact Summit 2026, highlighting systematic progress in infrastructure, talent development, governance alignment and real-world AI deployment.

item.title: Singapore: Manufacturing Adopts Industry 5.0 for a Resilient Future
item.description: Singapore’s manufacturing sector is advancing toward Industry 5.0, combining human-centric technology, sustainability and regional collaboration to drive competitiveness, resilience and workforce development.
